text:
morgan: Quick thread — proposal to switch the cohort hashing salt to `cohort_v2` for routing-priority. This will change which users hit latency-optimized paths. Want to run a shadow/dry-run + telemetry sampling before switching. Thoughts?

raj: Shadow first for sure. Start at 0.5–1% traffic, check p50/p95 latency, error rate, and cache-hit-rate by cohort label. Also compare token-costs.

anya: Console needs a preview toggle and a cohort-diff view so product owners can inspect who moves. Also we should emit a `route.delta` metric when a request would be routed differently under the new salt.

sam: Does the new salt reassign quota buckets? If user->quota mapping uses hash(user_id) we could double-count or misassign reserved capacity.

helen: If quota keys are derived from the user hash then yes — we should keep the legacy bucket alive for a grace window and mark new ones as `pending-migration`. That avoids immediate billing/throughput surprises.

ops-bot: snapshot created: config-snapshot s-1768009999 (cohort_salt_change) — owners: morgan, anya.

morgan: Proposed rollout plan: 1) Shadow routing (0.5%) for 6h with `preview=true` 2) Console preview for owners with cohort diff 3) Canary 5% for 2h 4) Ramp to 25/50/100% with telemetry gates. Need: dashboard queries, alert thresholds, a rollback playbook.

raj: Example queries I'll add to the eval job — start with Prometheus + traces.

```# p95 latency by routing_salt label
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="router",routing_salt=~"(cohort_v2|cohort_v1)"}[5m])) by (le, routing_salt))
```
And a comparison series: `increase(requests_total{routing_salt="cohort_v2",preview="true"}[30m]) / increase(requests_total{routing_salt="cohort_v1"}[30m])` to see redistribution.

anya: Telemetry notes: tag traces/metrics with `routing_salt=cohort_v2` and `preview=true` for shadow runs. Also add `cohort_id` as a separate label so we can diff distributions without having to infer from hash.

sam: Shadowing duplicates work — for anything that triggers external side-effects (billing, external syncs) we should short-circuit. Use header `x-rw-shadow: true` and router should `if header => skip_side_effects=true`. Also avoid full-model calls where possible (use cached KV or light probe).

helen: For quota service I'll implement: create new bucket keys but route reads first from legacy mapping then from new mapping if legacy absent. Mark new keys `pending-migration` and backfill counts for 24h. That keeps quotas stable.

morgan: Who owns dashboards and console pieces? @anya for dashboard/console preview, @raj for evals/alerts, @helen for quota migration, @sam for shadow-run guardrails.

anya: :thumbsup: I'll own dashboard + console preview. Will need a small table to store cohort diff snapshots and a preview endpoint. Putting a PR up tomorrow AM.

raj: Note on stats: at tiny sample rates p95 is noisy. Use ratio tests and bootstrapped CI for p95 comparisons; we'll also track relative change in request latency percentiles and a trimmed-mean for stability. I'll wire alerts: fire if `route_error_rate > 0.5%` or `p95_delta > 50ms` sustained 5m.

deploy-bot: canaries scheduled: 1768010200 for cohort_salt_canary. Auto-cancel if `route_error_rate > 0.5%` for 5m.

sam: Add runtime failover: if `p95(cohort_v2) - p95(cohort_v1) > 50ms` for 5m then traffic should revert to legacy path for affected cohorts. Also throttle ramp if token-costs increase > 10%.

helen: I'll add migration TTL 24h and a short backfill job to reconcile counts. Also adding an audit log entry for any cohort key creation.

morgan: Scheduling: dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PST. Owners confirmed. I'll write a short RFC and runbook (rollback steps, how to reassign quotas, how to unpublish preview).

anya: I'll drop dashboard links here once PRs merge.

raj: I'll add the eval job and an alert channel `#ops-alerts` hook.

sam: I'll add the shadow header enforcement and a small canary abort script.

morgan: thanks all — will follow up with RFC + invite to a 20m coordination sync at 09:15 PST.

helen: noted, will tag infra and billing to watch the 24h window.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: dry-run reminder 1768010100 (30m before).
